title: About Us
name: Guyu Sun
paragraphs: Hi, my name is Guyu Sun. I am a senior at New York University (NYU), and I am sharing a little about myself on this page.

As part of my coursework, I am completing a full MERN-stack web application exercise. My work on this assignment includes creating this personal introduction page and connecting its React interface to an Express back-end.
The portrait on this page is a photo of me. If you would like to get in touch, you can reach me at my NYU email address, gs3998@nyu.edu.
